chunks: Whoever performs hajj on behalf of a person, the two share together until, when he completes the obligatory tawaf, the sharing is cut off. So whatever deed is after that belongs to that pilgrim.

key_terms.إِنْسَانٍ: another person on whose behalf the hajj is performed
key_terms.اِشْتَرَكَا: the two shared together in reward
key_terms.اِنْقَطَعَتِ اَلشِّرْكَةُ: the sharing came to an end

ai.seo_question: Until what point is the reward shared when someone performs hajj on behalf of another person?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling on shared reward in deputized hajj. The one performing hajj on behalf of another shares in reward with that person up to the completion of the obligatory tawaf, after which subsequent acts belong specifically to the pilgrim performing them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2240 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever performs Hajj on behalf of another shares in the reward with them until the obligatory Tawaf is completed. After that, any deed performed is solely for the one performing the Hajj."
